final: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS value FROM rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mean_rate.value AS rate_above_mean FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN mean_rate WHERE r.rate > mean_rate.value
